A '''Whiphid male''' was incarcerated on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]]-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] and resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Deadend]]. In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], he attacked [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] at the [[Black Hole (Kiffex)|Black Hole]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] but was put to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
